title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC's Kenji Kamiyama Helms Gundam RG XARX-ZERO Anime in 2027
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced at San Diego Comic-Con International on Thursday that Kenji Kamiyama ( Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Star Wars: Visions ' "The Ninth Jedi", Eden of the East ), is directing the new Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO anime at Sola Animation for release next year.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Look Back Film Screens in Competition at Venice Int'l Film Fest
content: The Venice International Film Festival will take place from September 2-12 in Venice Lido, Italy. The Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) will screen the film's North American premiere. TIFF will take place on September 10-20. The festival will reveal its release schedule on August 11.
author: ANN

title: Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO Anime Announced as Part of Kenji Kamiyama's New Multimedia RG Project
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks has officially announced Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO , a brand-new TV anime directed by Kenji Kamiyama ( Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim ) as part of the newly unveiled RG Project . The project was previously teased earlier this month.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yen Press Licenses 'Let's Begin, a Battle Without the Hero,' The Weakling Who Died a Million Times Light Novels; The Dragon Prince's Ill-Mated Betrothal Manga
content: Yen Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed two light novel series under its Yen On imprint, and one manga title. Yen Press also announced the audiobook of the novel adaptation of Mamoru Hosoda 's Wolf Children: Ame & Yuki film, under its Yen Audio imprint. Title: Let's Begin, a Battle Without the Hero vol.

title: Over The Garden Wall Set For 2026 Return With “Expanded Edition Book”
content: Despite only having one season to its name, Over The Garden Wall has become one of the biggest animated original stories in Cartoon Network’s history. Every fall, the story of Gregory and Wirt is routinely revisited worldwide, with fans continuing to praise the series to this day.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Game's Trailer Reveals July 30 Release for 'Super Limit Breaking NEO' DLC
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming on Thursday a trailer for the new "Super Limit Breaking NEO" DLC for Dragon Ball : Sparking! Zero , the new game in the Dragon Ball Z : Budokai Tenkaichi arena fighter franchise , and it reveals that the DLC will launch on July 30.
author: ANN
